newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson to supply jet fighter equipment.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson to supply jet fighter equipment.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company Ericsson said on Thursday it had won a contract worth around one billion crowns for electronics equipment for the third series of Sweden's JAS Gripen fighter jet.
The contract would be shared by two Ericsson divisions, Microwave Systems and Ericsson Saab Avionics, Ericsson said in a statement.
The order follows a decision by the Swedish government last week to order a third batch of 64 JAS 39 Gripen fighters for the Swedish Air Force.
The Jas Gripen is made by Sweden's Saab in a partnership with British Aerospace.
Ericsson said its deliveries of radar, computer and presentation systems would start in 2003 and continue until the year 2007.
"The order is very significant for Ericsson Microwave Systems," said the unit's managing director Jan-Ake Kark in the statement.
"It also means we will certainly be a supplier for future export clients when Saab and its partner British Aerospace get export orders to elsewhere in Europe and Latin America."
